resources.string: Swipe right from inside the home to open the terminal. Type an app, a contact, open camera, turn off Wi-Fi or web followed by a query. Nothing runs until you select a result or press Search.
Leave the device name empty to use the phone model. Names accept letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.
This action is unavailable on this phone.
Use the system Wi-Fi control to complete the action.

Export a ZIP with your favourites, layout, sizes, terminal prompt and imported font. Notifications, contacts, weather data, Android permissions and welcome state are excluded. The file can contain personal names and your font: share it only when appropriate. Import replaces launcher preferences after confirmation; missing apps are removed from favourites and calendar selection may need updating on another phone.
Could not save the complete backup. Try another file location.
Invalid, incompatible or unreadable backup. Your configuration was not replaced.
Replace your current launcher preferences? Favourites in this backup: %1$d. Font and layout will be restored; Android permissions stay unchanged.
